description: Starts one durable layout job for boardRef at expectedRevision and returns generation.id and generation.status without waiting. create_board and update_board start layout automatically, so call this only to retry: after a failed or cancelled layout, after a save returned layoutNotStarted, or to regenerate a current layout. If a layout of that same revision is already running or was just saved, returns that job instead of starting another. Use the latest revision from get_generation or get_board. Read status with get_generation using the same boardRef; do not regenerate to inspect progress. Successful completion replaces the saved layout. A requestId supports IDENTICAL retries only; changed arguments need a new requestId. revision_conflict requires get_board; board_busy identifies the existing job to poll. Subject to normal compute capacity and board complexity limits, without AI credits.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

expectedRevision.description: Latest saved revision: boardRevision from get_generation, or revision from get_board. A completed layout advances it after create_board or update_board returns. A mismatch returns revision_conflict; read the board again before preparing a new operation.

requestId.description: New UUID for this operation. Reuse it with identical arguments when retrying an uncertain result; use a new UUID for a different operation.

name: generate_layout
title: Generate PCB layout
